items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: waited for Flemming because our trombone player got pneumonia there

ctx.x: Friedrichsberg, I think, and waited for Flemming because our trombone player got pneumonia there, see? And, but up in Leningrad we had a wonderful time. We bought some sable coats. I bought a sable coat, and two or three other boys bought sables. And I bought a four carat diamond ring, and things like that. The government hadn't seized yet, you know?
